title: Did Aristotle Use a Laptop? A Question Answering Benchmark with Implicit Reasoning Strategies
reasoning: The paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. While 'Religious' is listed as one of many reasoning skill categories in the dataset (e.g., asking about baptism), it is not a focus of the work but rather an example of a topic area covered by the general-purpose question-answering benchmark.
